cards.stem: About how much plutonium by weight is in spent fuel from U.S. reactors
cards.quote: Spent nuclear fuel from U.S. reactors contains about 1 percent plutonium by weight.
cards.hint: Recall the share stated for spent fuel

cards.stem: What atomic number is given for this metallic element
cards.quote: Plutonium is a radioactive metallic element with the atomic number 94.

cards.stem: Which radiation is described as predominantly emitted
cards.quote: Plutonium predominantly emits alpha particles – a type of radiation that is easily stopped and has a short range.

cards.stem: What half-life is listed for Pu-239
cards.quote: Pu-239 has a half-life of 24,100 years
cards.hint: Find the half-life sentence for this isotope
